title: 1922 The bridge was covered and concrete piers were near completion. Picture taken Dec 15, 1921
description: By the beginning of 1922, the bridge was fully covered, as seen here from the east side of the river in Hartland. Ben Irving, a local carpenter, crafted the bridge’s first sign, which had not yet been installed. The new tunnel-like structure quickly drew complaints from residents: the sound of horses’ hooves on loose floorboards echoed through the valley, disturbing sleep, and the darkness inside was unsettling. Maintenance crews had to return several times to add spikes to the floor, and eventually installed lights to address these issues.
